en.summary: United Russia secured victory in elections to the Kaliningrad region's legislative assembly.

stories.title: ЦИК: явка на выборах в Госдуму составила 59%. «Единая Россия» получает 355 мест в парламенте (это конституционное большинство)

en.title: CEC: turnout in State Duma elections reached 59%. United Russia receives 355 seats in parliament (constitutional majority)
en.summary: Voter turnout in State Duma elections reached 59.32%, with United Russia gaining 355 parliamentary seats, achieving a constitutional majority.

en.title: Central Election Commission: United Russia receives 57.82% of votes. Party candidates lead in 208 of 225 single-mandate districts
en.summary: United Russia obtained 57.82% of federal list votes with candidates leading in 208 out of 225 single-mandate districts, based on 83.52% of processed protocols.

en.title: Banks will be required to account for utility debt and alimony when issuing loans
